Sunday Night Heat: The Hurricane pinned Steven Richards at 3:05 with the Vertebreaker
Pay-per-view bouts – featured Jim Ross & Jerry Lawler on commentary for the Raw bouts and Michael Cole & Tazz on commentary for the Smackdown! matches; included an opening backstage segment with the Undertaker and Kane in which the only words said were Kane asking “So, how was your week?;” featured Sho Funaki conducting a backstage interview with Al Wilson about the attention he had received recently from Dawn Marie, with Funaki eventually asking why he was wearing clothing when he was caught in the shower with Dawn; included Jonathan Coachman conducting a backstage interview with Rob Van Dam regarding his match later in the show against Ric Flair; moments later, Coachman tried to get a comment from WWE World Champion Brock Lesnar, Paul Heyman, and Tracy about Lesnar’s match later in the show against Taker; featured a backstage segment with the Big Show and Stephanie McMahon in which Eric Bischoff interrupted, asking what his Raw talent was doing talking to Stephanie; after Stephanie walked off, Show complained to Bischoff he wasn’t being used right on Raw and it was Bischoff’s fault; after Bischoff told him off, Show grabbed him and threatened to hurt him if he didn’t start putting him in main events; included a video package highlighting the history of the IC title, to hype the Kane / Triple H match later in the show; featured a backstage segment with Chris Benoit and Eddie Guerrero, with Benoit saying Chavo Guerrero Jr. was being attacked by Kurt Angle; as Eddie tried to say it wasn’t Chavo behind the closed door and it was a trap, Angle threw Chavo out into the hallway and Eddie was held back by security as he tried to get at Angle & Benoit; included a backstage segment with Stephanie and Tracy in which Tracy said she had a relationship with Taker in the past and had been lying because Heyman put her up to it; moments later, Taker appeared and called Tracy a lying bitch, with Stephanie then ordering Tracy to leave; featured Taker convincing the trainer to give him a pain shot to his injured hand so he could compete in his match later in the show; included Rikishi at The World commenting on his experience in Hell in a Cell being thrown off the roof by Taker:
WWE Raw Tag Team Champions Chris Jericho & Christian defeated Booker T & Goldust at 8:48 when Jericho pinned Goldust with a bulldog onto one of the title belts followed by a moonsault off the top; during the closing moments of the match, Jericho attempted a Lionsault on Booker but the middle rope became unhinged
Torrie Wilson pinned Dawn Marie with a swinging neckbreaker at 4:41
Rob Van Dam pinned Ric Flair with a spin kick and the Five Star Frog Splash at 8:01
WWE Cruiserweight Champion Jamie Noble (w/ Nidia) pinned Tajiri at 8:15 by blocking a victory roll after Nidia held onto Noble to prevent the champion from being taken down; after the bout, Tajiri kissed Nidia on the lips, with Noble then attempting to show Tajiri how a real man kisses a woman; as he went to do so, Tajiri kicked Noble in the back of the head, knocking him out
World Heavyweight Champion Triple H pinned WWE IC Champion Kane at 16:14 in a unification match after ramming the challenger into the corner and following with the Pedigree after Kane caught an interfering Ric Flair coming off the top and hit the chokeslam; Flair appeared mid-way through the match, prompting the Hurricane to appear to counter Flair’s interference; moments later, Triple H dropped Hurricane with a Pedigree on the floor (The Twisted, Disturbed Life of Kane)
WWE Smackdown! Tag Team Championship Tournament Finals: Kurt Angle & Chris Benoit defeated Edge & Rey Mysterio Jr. at 22:00 when Edge submitted to Angle’s ankle lock, moments after Angle reversed Edge’s hold into his own (voted Match of the Year by the Wrestling Observer Newsletter and Pro Wrestling Torch)
WWE Women’s Champion Trish Stratus pinned Victoria at 5:34 with a roll up after Victoria avoided the bulldog; after the bout, Victoria kicked Trish until she was forced from the ring by the referee
WWE World Champion Brock Lesnar (w/ Paul Heyman) pinned the Undertaker in a Hell in a Cell match by reversing an attempt at the tombstone and hitting the F5 at 27:15; after the bout, Lesnar grabbed the belt, scaled to the roof of the cage, and posed as the show came to a close (Brock Lesnar: Here Comes the Pain, Tombstone: The History of the Undertaker, Hell in a Cell)

Smackdown! – 11/7/02 – featured an opening video package recapping Big Show assaulting WWE World Champion Brock Lesnar the previous week; hosted by Michael Cole & Tazz; included a backstage segment in which Big Show walked in the building and told a stagehand to inform Lesnar that he had arrived; featured a backstage segment in which Torrie Wilson spoke with her dad, with her dad saying he was going to do something for him later in the broadcast and he hoped she would understand; included Sho Funaki conducting a backstage interview with John Cena about facing Rikishi, with Cena cutting a battle rap until Rikishi interrupted and did his own battle rap; featured a backstage segment in which Stephanie McMahon watched footage of Eric Bischoff forcing himself on her the previous week, with Eddie & Chavo Guerrero Jr. walking in and saying they deserved the tag team title shot later in the show instead of Edge & Rey Mysterio Jr.; Stephanie said she would have a big announcement Tuesday regarding the tag team titles before telling Eddie he could face Lesnar if he wanted to face a champion; included a backstage segment in which Matt Hardy advised Shannon Moore not to put sugar in his coffee, then referred to Moore as his first Mattitude Follower (MFer); Matt then said he was going to address Lesnar; featured a backstage segment with Al Wilson and Dawn Marie in which Dawn questioned if Al was making the right decision about asking “that question” in public, with Al saying he was going to ask the question in the ring; included a backstage segment in which Hardy found Paul Heyman, noted he softened up the Undertaker for Lesnar in their Hell in a Cell match, and was going to demand a match with Show to do the same for Survivor Series; after Heyman thanked Hardy and went into Lesnar’s locker room, Heyman told Lesnar about the Hardy vs. Show match until Lesnar noted he was the one that wanted a match with Show; Heyman responded by telling Lesnar to focus on facing Guerrero; featured an in-ring segment in which Al Wilson took the mic and asked for Dawn to join him in the ring; moments later, Al told Dawn how she made him feel before getting down on one knee to ask her to marry him; Dawn slowly strutted back and forth until Al threatened to kill himself, with Dawn eventually saying yes and Al putting the ring of her finger; the commentary team made fun of the segment throughout; included an ad promoting the WWE Anthology CD set; featured the announcement Kane, Jeff Hardy, Booker T, & Bubba Ray Dudley would face World Heavyweight Champion Triple H, 3 Minute Warning, WWE Raw Tag Team Champions Chris Jericho & Kane on WWE Super Tuesday and Edge would face Chris Benoit and Eddie Guerrero; included a backstage interview with Show in which he said he himself would win the Lesnar vs. Eddie match; featured a backstage segment in which Eddie & Chavo found Heyman outside Lesnar’s dressing room; moments later, Eddie agreed that Show couldn’t beat Show at Survivor Series nor could he beat him; Lesnar then stormed out of his dressing room, with Heyman dressing him down for not listening to him despite everything he had done for Lesnar; Heyman then said Lesnar could face Eddie without him at ringside; included a vignette promoting the debut of Scott Steiner:
Billy Kidman & Torrie Wilson defeated WWE Cruiserweight Champion Jamie Noble & Nidia at 5:07 when Kidman pinned Noble with the Shooting Star Press as Torrie and Nidia fought on the floor; during the bout, it was noted Torrie would face Trish Stratus the following Tuesday on WWE Super Tuesday on UPN
Rikishi pinned John Cena at 4:13 with the Bonzai Drop
The Big Show pinned Matt Hardy at 1:59 by catching Hardy coming off the top and hitting the chokeslam; during Show’s entrance, Kevin Kelly tried to speak with Torrie Wilson backstage about Al Wilson and Dawn Marie’s engagement, with a tearful Torrie not answering and instead running out of the building with her bags; WWE World Champion Brock Lesnar and Paul Heyman were shown watching on backstage during the contest; after the match, Show took the mic and said he would be the new WWE World Champion at Survivor Series; moments later, Lesnar grabbed the TV he was watching backstage and smashed it
Edge & Rey Mysterio Jr. defeated WWE Smackdown! Tag Team Champions Kurt Angle & Chris Benoit in a Best 2 out of 3 falls match to win the titles at around the 25-minute mark; fall #1: Mysterio pinned Benoit at 5:59 with a springboard senton as Edge hoisted Benoit up for a powerbomb; fall #2: Edge submitted to Angle’s ankle lock at 9:26 after Benoit hit Edge with one of the title belts behind the referee’s back the challengers initially won the third fall Mysterio pinned Angle at around the 16-minute mark with a roll up, with the referee not seeing Angle grabbing the rope during the cover; during the commercial break, the match was ordered to continue; fall #3: Edge pinned Angle after hitting the spear, and after Benoit accidentally hitting his own partner with the headbutt off the top
WWE World Champion Brock Lesnar pinned Eddie Guerrero (w/ Chavo Guerrero Jr.) in a non-title match at 6:41 with the F5; after the bout, Lesnar celebrated at the entrance stage until Big Show jumped him from behind and press slammed him off the stage; moments later, Paul Heyman and referees tended to Lesnar as Show looked on
